name: mic-noise-canceller
description: Manifest V3 Chrome extension: real-time client-side mic noise cancellation via RNNoise (WASM) with a JS fallback engine.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/zip.mjs
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import {rmSync} from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})"
